thread:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: yesterday's metering cascade resulted in late ledger writes and a duplicated-batch pattern that bumped token totals for ~0.6% of invoices. We need owners for remediation, credits, and detection.

kai: I can own detection & long-term root cause. plan: instrument consumer checkpoints, add idempotency token, and keep an audit counter. ETA Thu (2026-03-26).

asha: I'll own customer credits and invoice corrections. Proposal: two-phase credits (auto small credits + manual review for large accounts). Drafting spreadsheet now. ETA Tue EOD (2026-03-24).

zane: ops can patch the consumer to prevent re-ingest when replay flag is set. will create PR and a rollback. ETA Wed morning (2026-03-25).

ellie-fin: Finance needs a canonical list of impacted invoices with a reason_code column. @asha pls add a short message we can send customers.

billing-bot: Created ticket MET-5405 "Consumer replay/backfill causing duplicate token writes" 10: assignees: zane,asha,kai 10: due 2026-03-29

kai: quick query to identify likely duplicates (use as starting point):

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as rows, MIN(inserted_at) as first_seen, MAX(inserted_at) as last_seen
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE source = 'metering-consumer' AND inserted_at >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

morgan: Action items summarized: 
- zane: consumer guard + rollback plan (ETA 2026-03-25)
- kai: detection + idempotency work + RC doc (ETA 2026-03-26)
- asha: credits spreadsheet + customer template (ETA 2026-03-24)
- ellie-fin: validation & sign-off on CSV (ETA 2026-03-25)

Please ack here when you start work and add links to MET-5405. we'll validate at the next billing sync.

zane: ack 10 starting patch branch now. will include test that simulates replay.

asha: ack 10 uploading draft credits sheet to MET-5405 in 30m.

kai: ack. starting instrumenting consumer checkpoints this afternoon.

ellie-fin: ack. will run a cross-check against subscriptions and flag any outliers > $500.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow up meeting scheduled Fri 10:00 for MET-5405 remediation review.

morgan: thanks all. two requests: keep customer comms centralized (cc: ellie-fin), and note any recurring pattern indicators (consumer restarts, backlog spikes) in the RC doc. :thumbsup:
